assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia as a potential etiology for transient cerebral ischemic events
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded as CPT 93271
The claim was denied under CO-22
The denial reason CO-22 indicates coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
The payer is the secondary payer and cannot process the claim until primary liability is determined and satisfied
The payer is Prairie State Medicaid
The patient has the right to appeal the denial
